title: Canvas tool family umbrella - taxonomy agreed, five cards sequenced behind it
description:
Umbrella over the canvas tool family. The ARCHITECTURE was settled with the user on 2026-08-01 and lives in brief.md: three toolbar groups (Mask / Paint / Composite), a floating Detect strip replacing three stacked buttons, and TWO shared engines - one brush and one shape gizmo, each mounted twice with a different destination layer. Composite becomes one operation with two front ends, fed by pasted slots instead of a modal.

MPI-379 was REJECTED outright in the brainstorm this card scheduled - canvas-side hover selection is complexity the user does not want; the thumb strip and the Detect button stay.

Order: MPI-425 (taxonomy, the frame everything mounts into) -> MPI-382 (Adjust) -> MPI-368 (shape gizmo, two mounts) -> MPI-375 (paint layer, brush engine, alpha brushes) -> MPI-373 (composite group). MPI-421 is independent and can land at any point. This card holds no implementation of its own and closes when the last of them ships.
acceptance: MPI-379 was brainstormed with the user 2026-08-01 and REJECTED outright - closed, recorded, not trimmed and not parked as candidates
The agreed taxonomy is recorded in brief.md and every affected card carries its re-scope: 425 new, 382 Adjust, 368 two mounts, 375 brush engine + alpha brushes, 373 composite group, 421 one panel
The five cards ship in the recorded order - 425 first, because every other one mounts into the groups it declares
No card in the set starts before the one above it has shipped, unless this card records why the order changed
This card holds no implementation of its own and closes only when the last of the five is done
